item.name: scroll-showcase
item.summary: Scroll composition: StickyScrollStory + ScrollReveal + optional Marquee (DOM, ~6 KB gz, reduced motion -> static/opacity, mobile -> stacked)

useWhen: Product feature narrative requiring sticky step progression and reveal on scroll
Architecture or engineering deep-dive with synchronized technical media and metrics
Multi-section storytelling with accessible scroll-driven reveals
avoidWhen: Short single-screen pages without scroll depth
Mobile web apps requiring dense vertical list views
Documentation sites where uninterrupted linear reading is essential

alternatives.name: sticky-scroll-story
alternatives.when: When you only need the sticky step column without accompanying feature grids or marquee

alternatives.name: scroll-reveal
alternatives.when: When you only need basic reveal-on-scroll animations for individual cards

tiers.0: Static stacked layout, all cards and text fully visible, static marquee row
tiers.1: Static stacked layout, touch-safe scroll, marquee autoscroll off
tiers.2: Sticky scroll progression, CSS scroll reveal, smooth marquee ticker
tiers.3: Full sticky scroll progression, CSS view-timeline reveals, interactive marquee

reducedMotion.description: StickyScrollStory transitions with quick opacity swap <= 150ms; ScrollReveal elements are immediately visible; Marquee is rendered as a manually scrollable row with autoscroll disabled

input.pointer: Fine pointer hover pauses marquee and enables interactive media exploration
input.touch: Coarse pointer falls back to stacked layout on mobile without sticky jumps
input.keyboard: Fully keyboard navigable: Tab lands in reading order through all steps, cards, and marquee items

a11y.notes: Semantic landmark sections with aria-labelledby and aria-label. DOM reading order matches visual order. Heading hierarchy (h2 -> h3 -> h4) maintained. Alt text provided on all media items.

props.name: steps
props.effect: Array of story steps with id, title, description, and media.

props.name: showMarquee
props.effect: Includes the partner and studio reference marquee ticker.

props.name: smoothScroll
props.effect: Wraps the composition in SmoothScroll provider (disabled by default).

props.name: className
props.effect: Additional CSS class names on root container.

props.name: style
props.effect: Inline styles applied to root container.

mistakes: Do not enable smoothScroll on dashboards or documentation pages.
Do not place multiple sticky scroll sections immediately adjacent to each other without spacing.
verify: Verify that the step sequence is fully accessible in DOM reading order.
Verify that mobile viewports switch to stacked mode without sticky jumping.
Verify that reduced-motion preferences disable autoscroll on marquee and reveals remain static.
